about: Renders a search field with a leading search mark and a control that clears the value. Escape clears the field, Enter submits the value, and the clear control is out of the tab order.

clearing.about: An empty field renders no clear control. The control appears with the first character and is removed with the last. It is a mark at the end of the group, so the typed text does not move when it appears.
clearing.title: With and without something to clear

controlled.about: `onValueChange` receives every change, a clear included. A caller that filters a list handles typing and clearing in one handler. Clearing moves focus back to the field.
controlled.title: Controlled by its caller

filters.about: `clearLabel` names the clear control after what it removes. On a field that filters a list the name is “Clear filters”. A screen reader user hears what a press removes.
filters.title: Naming what it clears

looks.about: The input group supplies three looks: outline, subtle and flushed. The search mark and the clear control use the muted ink on each look.
looks.title: Looks

size.about: Every size, each with a value so the clear control renders. The box, the marks and the control read the control scale at the same size.
size.title: Sizes

title: Search input
